physical.title: bangle
physical.summary: Flat, circular bangle made of ivory. The inner rim is slightly raised on front surface; central groove decorates outer edge of bangle. Inscription in ink on back of bangle reads: 'SOMALI. DJIBOUTI JAN 1898'.
